item.title: 4 ways to avoid getting ripped off, according to a pricing expert
item.description: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

item.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
item.description: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes at a time when the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel, and continues with the stalemated, seven-month-old war on Iran.

item.description: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

item.title: OpenAI delays latest model over security concerns, as industry faces pressure
item.description: OpenAI's decision to hold back the model, called GPT-6.1 Astra, comes amid a broader push within the industry to slow the development of increasingly autonomous systems until safety measures catch up.

item.title: Tennessee is set to execute a woman for the first time in 200 years
item.description: One of the youngest women sent to death row is set to be executed in Tennessee. If carried out as scheduled Wednesday, it would be Tennessee's first execution of a woman in 200 years.

item.title: The Senate passes the Protect College Sports Act, but the bill's future is unclear
item.description: The bill's supporters, which include the NCAA, say it will tame what they call a "Wild West" era of college sports as litigation chips away at long-held rules around eligibility, transfers and pay.

item.title: I didn't think 'Pachinko' could be topped. Then I read 'American Hagwon'
item.description: Min Jin Lee's new novel is the third in a planned four-novel series about the Korean diaspora. Nearly 10 years in the making, this sweeping-but-intimate 600+ page book is overwhelming — in a good way.

item.title: Prosecutors are reopening a Cornell fraternity rape case. Here's what we know
item.description: New York prosecutors are reopening an investigation into an alleged rape case at Cornell University in 2024. The alleged victim recently filed a lawsuit against seven members of Chi Phi fraternity.

item.title: Trump's immigration push has largely spared farms. Idaho dairymen worry it won't last.
item.description: America's farms have largely escaped the president's aggressive immigration crackdown. But as ICE sweeps continue across the nation, farmers are uneasy because many still can't find enough workers.
